newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian agency to open fresh Azomures sale talks.
newsitem.headline: Romanian agency to open fresh Azomures sale talks.

text.p: Romania's main privatisation body said on Wednesday it would reopen negotiations on the sale of fertiliser maker Azomures after a previous agreement fell through.
"We will invite Omnimpex, the second bidder for the (Azomures) stake, at the negotiating table," State Ownership Fund (FPS) spokesman Stefan Ciochinaru, told Reuters.
Earlier this week the FPS cancelled a contract to sell 51 percent in Azomures to Romanian trading company Euro Trading Chemicals SRL after it failed to meet a payment deadline.
Euro Trading won the February tender for Azomures shares, but the bidding sparked controversy.
Romania's main competition supervisor opened an inquiry into alleged tender irregularities after complaints from Omnimpex Chemicals, which was beaten in the tender.
On Wednesday Omnimpex said it was ready to talk to the FPS.
"We'll maintain our initial offer of 90,000 lei per share, which will bring the total worth of the deal to 384 billion lei," said Omnimpex administrator Ionel Baibarac.
But he said Omnimpex wanted an update of Azomures' financial situation in the wake of its involvement with Euro Trading.

Azomures has been a Bucharest stock exchange star ever since it began trading last January. Earlier this year, its strong bourse performance and sound financial results gained it a place on the bourse's top tier, where listing criteria are tougher.
